assumptions.rationale: First transfer date with a completed 2017-18 seasonal feature set.
Latest date with a full two-year horizon before the final valuation observation.
Pre-transfer valuation must be on/before transfer and no more than this many days old.
Nearest valuation must fall within +/- this many days of the 12m or 24m target.
Coverage floor before treating no player appearances as a valid 12m outcome.
Coverage floor before treating no player appearances as a valid 24m outcome.
Positive fees can still include loan fees; transfer movement type is unavailable and must be classified.
A valuation proxy, not realized accounting profit or resale ROI.
Counts are summed; per-90 and percentage metrics are minutes-weighted across player-season rows.

funnels.stage: Destination coverage: >=10 games at 12m and >=20 at 24m
funnels.note: Allows zero player appearances to be interpreted as an outcome
